hypothesis: A separate learned low-rank user-item residual can capture preference structure omitted by the incumbent fixed8D preference/exposure factors. This changes model capacity across the population.
baseline: Exact public-best V136; primary and weekend proxies from runtime/v136 use V65 plus half-context.
training: Frozen catalog/user mean utility offsets. Real clicked slates plus unique prewindow warm clicks with9 sampled exposure-pool alternatives. Warm loss weight2. Same batches and random negatives for all3 models.8 fixed epochs, Adam lr.02 cosine decay, batch4096; residual L2 precision3 and item-bias precision20, global log-temperature quadratic penalty.
initialization: First16 normalized sparse real conditional-residual SVD dimensions, n_iter7 seed137026; per-coordinate initial scale.1 after sqrt(population) scaling.

recipes.delta: Treated conditional logits minus matched control, center within10 candidates then .3*tanh(delta/.3); preserve V136 event mass.

screen: Primary gain>=.00005, first day and delayed positive, third day nonnegative, nonworse logloss. Require matched weekend and both dates positive. Retain all results. No public score claim.
limits: Reused V136 proxy development data; exact V108/V136 held-out head unavailable.
